//: Type checker for the server. Nothing is emitted: Node runs .ts files directly by stripping the types (Node >= 22.18), so there is no build step. .ts files are always checked; a .js file opts in with `// @ts-check` on its first line. The server is moving from .js to .ts file by file (docs/typescript-migration.md). erasableSyntaxOnly forbids the TypeScript features Node cannot strip (enum, namespace, parameter properties); verbatimModuleSyntax makes a type-only import say `import type`, so Node never tries to load an export that only exists as a type.
